items.description: Designing and shipping scalable web platforms, backend services, and AI-enabled features while owning system architecture, code quality, cloud deployments, performance, and technical mentoring across the delivery lifecycle.

Led end-to-end product delivery, translating business requirements into maintainable full-stack and cloud solutions while guiding architecture, code reviews, API design, releases, and day-to-day technical direction.

Delivered web and mobile products across varied industries, taking work from discovery and system design through full-stack development, API integrations, database architecture, deployment, optimization, and long-term support.
